Figure 2. Precursor feeding experiments of H. meridiana OUCLQ22-B7. (A) HPLC analysis of the
secondary metabolites of H. meridiana OUCLQ22-B7 in CYCG medium. (i) CYCG medium; (ii) CYCG
medium supplemented with 2.5 mM indole; (iii) CYCG medium supplemented with 2.5 mM L-
Trp; (B) UV absorbance of the oligoindoles. Indole (retention time: 18.4 min) and L-Trp (retention
time: 6.9 min) were shown in Figure S3. Blue peaks represent compounds for which L-Trp is the
biosynthetic precursor, while red peaks represent compounds derived from indole.
